scope: Read-only feasibility for replacing the finite wordlist after actual rejection of ordinary paraphrases; no new platform, dataset or product build.

singleRecommendation.license: Apache-2.0; model author page, official Ollama library and local license layer agree
singleRecommendation.whyThisOne: The already cached instruction-tuned text model has official English and structured-JSON support claims, fits the measured machine capacity, and avoids adding a runtime/download solely for this bounded diagnosis. Its success on current quantity/stock commands remains untested.
singleRecommendation.proposedExecutionPath: One local POST to http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat with model=qwen2.5:7b, the current/original quantity+stock summary and exact user message, stream=false, and the existing intent JSON schema in format. Feed the actual response to the unchanged shared apply/solve/file checker. This is only a proposed path; no request or bridge was made.

capacityAssessment.basis: 4.68GB cached weights versus 24GiB physical RAM and 53% reported free at inspection; compact state and bounded context can avoid long-context allocation. Disk has approximately 101GB free; no download is needed.
capacityAssessment.unmeasured: Model resident memory, GPU allocation, actual cold/warm latency and effect of concurrent workloads not tested.
